title: Isolated reserve slots, adaptive backfill, and rollback for Dedicated capacity
creator: Priya Shah
description:
Executive summary: We will introduce an isolated reserve-slot primitive for Dedicated capacity that guarantees minimal throughput for critical tenants while enabling adaptive backfill of unused slots and a robust rollback path for bad rollouts. This feature is targeted at customers that buy reserved pools but need stronger isolation assurances and predictable fallbacks during autoscale or node failures. It combines reservation semantics (slot allocation), a backfill engine that opportunistically uses idle capacity without violating isolation, and a safe rollback mechanism to revert reserve assignments and routing rules when regressions are detected.

Goals:
- Provide short-term (seconds-to-minutes) isolation guarantees that prevent noisy neighbors from starving reserved tenants during bursts.
- Improve utilization by allowing adaptive backfill: lower-priority traffic can use idle reserved slots but must be preemptible within a predictable timeout/window.
- Enable safe rollback of reserve configuration and routing policies with automated mitigation in case of perf regressions or misconfigurations.
- Surface controls in Console and APIs so customers can define reserve slot policies, backfill duration, and rollback thresholds.

Success metrics:
- Reserved tenants see <10% tail-latency degradation under 95th-percentile cluster contention compared to baseline.
- Backfill utilization increases effective throughput by >=12% on average without increasing customer-visible errors for reserved tenants.
- Rollback tooling reduces mean time to remediate (MTTR) from misconfiguration from hours to <20 minutes in staged rollouts.

Audience and stakeholders: Dedicated product PM, Serving runtime team, Routing/Autoscale engineers, Console UX, Solutions Engineering, Key accounts (beta customers).
requirements: Affordable primitive: reserve_slot(resource_unit) that binds a capacity quantum to a tenant with configurable min_guarantee and preemptible flag
Backfill engine: can attach preemptible workloads to idle reserve slots with max_backfill_duration and preemption_grace_period
Preemption behavior: preempted backfill requests must receive a defined error code and an automatic retry policy recommended by SDKs
Routing policy: smart routing should prefer reserved slots for bound tenant traffic; when unavailable, determine fallback to shared pools or lower-latency variants
Configuration API: REST + SDK endpoints to create/update/delete reserve slots and backfill rules with audit-log entries
Console: UI surfaces for visualizing reserve slot utilization, active backfill, preemption history, and one-click rollback for a rollout
Safety/rollback: atomic rollback API that can revert the last N policy changes and optionally trigger proactive cold-starts for fallback capacity
Telemetry: metrics for reserved_slot_count, reserved_slot_active_ratio, backfill_utilization, preemptions_per_minute, rollback_invocations
Runbook: playbook describing operator steps during reserved-slot contention or failed rollback
out_of_scope: Long-term reservation marketplace / secondary trading of slots
Billing change to reservation pricing model (billing will use existing reserved capacity billing for now)
Cross-region automated rebalancing of reserved slots (zonal scope only in this phase)
ui_changes: New Reserve Slots tab under Dedicated -> Capacity with list, filters, and per-slot detail panel
Visualization: time-series of slot utilization and backfill overlay with preemption markers
One-click rollback button on per-slot detail that explains impact and shows recent diffs
Wizard to create reserve slot policy with min guarantee, max_backfill_duration, preemption_grace_period and labels
api_changes: POST /v1/dedicated/reserve_slots - create slot (tenant_id, min_guarantee, max_backfill_duration, preemptible)
PATCH /v1/dedicated/reserve_slots/{id} - update policy with optimistic concurrency token
POST /v1/dedicated/reserve_slots/{id}/rollback - rollback last change for slot id
GET /v1/dedicated/reserve_slots/{id}/telemetry - returns recent utilization and preemptions
acceptance_criteria: Create/update/delete reserve slot via API and Console and see corresponding audit log entries
Bound tenant maintains configured min_guarantee throughput during synthetic interference test at 95th percentile cluster load
Backfill tasks are scheduled on idle slots and receive documented preemption responses within preemption_grace_period
Preemption events and backfill utilization are recorded in telemetry and displayed in Console charts
Rollback API reverts last policy change and routing for the affected slot within expected SLA, and rollback events appear in audit logs
End-to-end e2e test (eng) exercises a staged rollout that triggers an automatic rollback when latency regression threshold is crossed
telemetry: reserved_slot_active_ratio - fraction of time slot is used by owner traffic
backfill_utilization - percentage of slot-time used by backfill workloads
migration_plan: Phase 0 (beta): opt-in for select enterprise tenants behind feature flag; manual handshake from Solutions Eng
Phase 1: GA of reserve slot primitive with Console and API for all Dedicated customers; default backfill off
Phase 2: enable adaptive backfill by default for tenants who consent; expose auto-optimize recommendations in Console
Rollback rehearsals: schedule simulated rollbacks during maintenance windows to validate instrumentation and MTTR
risks: Misconfigured backfill could increase noisy neighbor incidents if preemption is slow; requires tight preemption path
Rollback may not be instantaneous if downstream routing caches take time to converge; need TTL tuning and cache invalidation hooks
Incorrect usage of reserve slots by customers could create false expectations about long-term capacity guarantees; docs and UX must set clear SLAs
engineering_notes: Runtime should add lightweight slot token in routing header to speed preemption decisions
Backfill scheduler must be able to preempt within preemption_grace_period and enqueue notifications to SDKs
Need a migration task to backfill audit logs for pre-existing reserved pools into per-slot view
